title: Monthly Revenue Breakdown (PostgreSQL)
content:
Question: Show total monthly revenue for the current year.
SQL Pattern (PostgreSQL):
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue, COUNT(id) AS order_count
FROM demo.orders
WHERE status != 'CANCELLED'
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at)
ORDER BY month ASC;

title: Monthly Revenue Breakdown (MySQL Dialect)
content:
Question: Show total monthly revenue for MySQL dialect.
SQL Pattern (MySQL):
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-01') AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue, COUNT(id) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE status != 'CANCELLED'
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-01')
ORDER BY month ASC;

title: Safe Read-Only Query Constraints
content: Guideline: Always produce single SELECT statements. Never produce DROP, ALTER, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, or EXECUTE. In Demo mode, qualify tables with 'demo.' prefix. In Custom mode, use table names exactly as provided in SchemaCatalog.
